No new 5 Nov hearing order located by 07:24 IST; no outcome predicted.
CERT-In primary advisory targets financial institutions and APIs, not all retail accounts.
Result cross-checked with New Zealand Cricket archive scorecard and independent reports.
Release date confirmed; advance-booking estimate includes blocked seats and is not realised revenue.
West UP page issued 5 Nov shows no warning 5–11 Nov; southern subdivision warnings reopened 07:24 IST.
₹100 crore Dhanteras figure is a trader forecast, not audited or actual sales.
